===== dev/era/erenty/ui/EraRuntime.kt =====
// Generated by ERA. Do not edit: changes are overwritten on the next build.

package dev.era.erenty.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicText
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateListOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.staticCompositionLocalOf
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.DpSize
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle

/** A screen the host can show. */
class EraScreen(val name: String, val title: String?, val content: @Composable () -> Unit)

/** Navigation stack (M6). `go` pushes a screen, `back` pops one. */
object EraNav {
    val stack = mutableStateListOf<String>()
    val current: String? get() = stack.lastOrNull()
    val canGoBack: Boolean get() = stack.size > 1
    fun reset(screen: String) { stack.clear(); stack.add(screen) }
    fun go(screen: String) { stack.add(screen) }
    fun back() { if (stack.size > 1) stack.removeAt(stack.lastIndex) }
}

/** Shows the screen on top of the navigation stack (the start screen at first). */
@Composable
fun EraApp() {
    val name = EraNav.current ?: EraStartScreen
    val screen = EraScreens.firstOrNull { it.name == name } ?: EraScreens.first()
    screen.content()
}

/** The screen's size, for `vw`/`vh` units. Set by each screen. */
val LocalEraScreenSize = staticCompositionLocalOf { DpSize(402.dp, 874.dp) }

/** `50vw`: a share of the screen width. */
@Composable
fun eraVw(percent: Float): Dp = LocalEraScreenSize.current.width * (percent / 100f)

/** `50vh`: a share of the screen height. */
@Composable
fun eraVh(percent: Float): Dp = LocalEraScreenSize.current.height * (percent / 100f)

/** Numbers in text: `3.0` shows as `3`. */
fun eraText(x: Double): String =
    if (x % 1.0 == 0.0 && kotlin.math.abs(x) < 1e15) x.toLong().toString() else x.toString()

/** Text input with a placeholder. Bound to state with `bind`, otherwise it keeps its own text. */
@Composable
fun EraInput(
    placeholder: String,
    style: TextStyle,
    placeholderColor: Color,
    modifier: Modifier,
    value: String? = null,
    onValueChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    var local by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val text = value ?: local
    BasicTextField(
        value = text,
        onValueChange = { if (onValueChange != null) onValueChange(it) else local = it },
        modifier = modifier,
        textStyle = style,
        singleLine = true,
        decorationBox = { inner ->
            Box {
                if (text.isEmpty()) BasicText(placeholder, style = style.copy(color = placeholderColor))
                inner()
            }
        },
    )
}

package dev.era.erenty.ui

import dev.era.erenty.ui.screens.*

const val EraAppName: String = "E-Renty"
const val EraStartScreen: String = "Splash"

/** Every screen, in source order. */

    EraScreen("Home", "Overview") { HomeScreen() },
    EraScreen("Menu", "Menu") { MenuScreen() },
    EraScreen("Splash", "E-Renty") { SplashScreen() },

===== dev/era/erenty/ui/EraStores.kt =====
// Generated by ERA. Do not edit: changes are overwritten on the next build.

package dev.era.erenty.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue

/** `store Session` */
object Session {
    var verified: Boolean by mutableStateOf(false)
    var needsVerification: Boolean by mutableStateOf(true)

    fun verify() {
        verified = true
        needsVerification = false
    }

    fun signOut() {
        verified = false
        needsVerification = true
    }
}

/** This skin has no `colors dark`, so dark mode uses the light colors. */
val EraDarkColors: EraColors = EraLightColors

const val EraHasDarkMode: Boolean = false

object EraSpacing {
    val lg = 20.dp
    val md = 12.dp
    val sm = 8.dp
    val xl = 32.dp
    val xs = 4.dp
}

object EraRadius {
    val lg = 22.dp
    val md = 16.dp
    val pill = 999.dp
    val sm = 10.dp
    val xl = 28.dp
}

object EraBorder {
    val thick = 2.dp
    val thin = 1.dp
}

object EraElevation {
    val md = 8.dp
    val sm = 2.dp
}

/** Font: Inter. Loaded by the platform host. */
val EraFont: FontFamily by lazy { eraFontFamily(listOf("Fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf", "Fonts/Inter-Medium.ttf", "Fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf", "Fonts/Inter-SemiBold.ttf")) }

object EraType {
    val badge = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(600), lineHeight = 14.sp)
    val body = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(400), lineHeight = 22.sp)
    val bodyStrong = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 22.sp)
    val button = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 20.sp)
    val caption = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(400), lineHeight = 18.sp)
    val captionStrong = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 18.sp)
    val code = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 36.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 40.sp)
    val display = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 32.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 38.sp, letterSpacing = (-0.6).sp)
    val heading = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 28.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 34.sp, letterSpacing = (-0.4).sp)
    val label = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 20.sp)
    val subhead = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(400), lineHeight = 20.sp)
    val title = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 22.sp)
    val titleLg = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 26.sp)
}

val LocalEraColors = staticCompositionLocalOf { EraLightColors }

/** Provides the skin's colors; `dark` selects `colors dark` when the skin has it. */
@Composable
fun EraTheme(dark: Boolean = false, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalEraColors provides if (dark) EraDarkColors else EraLightColors,
        content = content,
    )
}

    val c = LocalEraColors.current
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(c.background)) {
        CompositionLocalProvider(LocalEraScreenSize provides DpSize(maxWidth, maxHeight)) {
            // scroll @VerifyCode:Page <Page>
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxHeight().background(c.surface).safeDrawingPadding().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                // column @VerifyCode:Page/0 <Page>
                Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(EraSpacing.lg), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(EraSpacing.lg, Alignment.Top)) {
                    // stack @VerifyCode:Page/0/0:IconTile <Page>IconTile>
                    Box(Modifier.width(44.dp).height(44.dp).shadow(EraElevation.sm, RoundedCornerShape(EraRadius.md), clip = false).background(c.surface, RoundedCornerShape(EraRadius.md)).clickable { EraNav.back() }, contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        // icon @VerifyCode:Page/0/0:IconTile/0 <Page>IconTile>
                        Image(painter = eraIcon("Icons/arrow_left.svg"), contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp), colorFilter = ColorFilter.tint(c.text))
                    }
                    // column @VerifyCode/slot/0
                    Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = EraSpacing.xl), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(EraSpacing.md, Alignment.Top), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                        // image @VerifyCode/slot/0/0
                        Image(painter = eraImage("Images/code.png"), contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.width(75.dp).height(53.dp), contentScale = ContentScale.Fit)
                        // text @VerifyCode/slot/0/1
                        BasicText("Enter your code", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.heading.copy(color = c.text, textAlign = TextAlign.Center))
                        // text @VerifyCode/slot/0/2
                        BasicText("We sent a 6-digit code to your email. Enter it to activate your account.", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.body.copy(color = c.muted, textAlign = TextAlign.Center))
                    }
                    // row @VerifyCode/slot/1
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = EraSpacing.xl), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(EraSpacing.md, Alignment.CenterHorizontally)) {
                        // row @VerifyCode/slot/1/0:OtpGroup <OtpGroup>
                        Row(Modifier.background(c.background, RoundedCornerShape(EraRadius.lg)).border(EraBorder.thick, c.focus, RoundedCornerShape(EraRadius.lg)).padding(horizontal = EraSpacing.lg, vertical = EraSpacing.md), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(EraSpacing.lg, Alignment.Start), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            // text @VerifyCode/slot/1/0/slot/0
                            BasicText("4", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.code.copy(color = c.text))
                            // text @VerifyCode/slot/1/0/slot/1
                            BasicText("–", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.code.copy(color = c.placeholder))
                            // text @VerifyCode/slot/1/0/slot/2
                            BasicText("–", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.code.copy(color = c.placeholder))
                        }
                        // row @VerifyCode/slot/1/1:OtpGroup <OtpGroup>
                        Row(Modifier.background(c.surface, RoundedCornerShape(EraRadius.lg)).border(EraBorder.thin, c.border, RoundedCornerShape(EraRadius.lg)).padding(horizontal = EraSpacing.lg, vertical = EraSpacing.md), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(EraSpacing.lg, Alignment.Start), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            // text @VerifyCode/slot/1/1/slot/0
                            BasicText("–", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.code.copy(color = c.placeholder))
                            // text @VerifyCode/slot/1/1/slot/1
                            BasicText("–", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.code.copy(color = c.placeholder))
                            // text @VerifyCode/slot/1/1/slot/2
                            BasicText("–", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.code.copy(color = c.placeholder))
                        }
                    }
                    // row @VerifyCode/slot/2
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = EraSpacing.xl, bottom = EraSpacing.lg), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(EraSpacing.xs, Alignment.CenterHorizontally)) {
                        // text @VerifyCode/slot/2/0
                        BasicText("Didn’t get a code?", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.body.copy(color = c.muted))
                        // text @VerifyCode/slot/2/1
                        BasicText("Resend in 0:42", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.bodyStrong.copy(color = c.secondary))
                    }
                    // button @VerifyCode/slot/3:AppButton <AppButton>
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(c.disabled, RoundedCornerShape(EraRadius.md)).clickable { Session.verify(); EraNav.back() }.padding(EraSpacing.md), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        BasicText("Verify", style = EraType.button.copy(color = c.muted))
                    }
                    // text @VerifyCode/slot/4
                    BasicText("Change email", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), style = EraType.bodyStrong.copy(color = c.secondary, textAlign = TextAlign.Center))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
